create.name: Alex Elle
create.bio:
Alex Elle, who publishes as Alexandra Elle, is a writer and teacher of what she calls restorative writing: journaling and reflective writing used as a steady practice for knowing yourself better. It started as her own private habit, and over more than ten years it has become the heart of her work. She is also a certified breathwork coach, and she often pairs short breathing practices and guided meditations with writing prompts, so that people slow down before they put pen to paper.

She is the author of several books, including the New York Times bestseller How We Heal, After the Rain, the poetry collection Neon Soul and, in 2026, The Company We Keep, which looks at friendship and growing alongside other people. Alongside these sit guided journals and affirmation cards. She teaches through workshops, online courses and retreats, speaks at universities and companies, and writes a free newsletter, Here for Now, with essays and journal prompts. Her short meditations on Insight Timer and her YouTube channel focus on gratitude, rest and self-kindness. She lives in Washington, D.C.

books.title: How We Heal: Uncover Your Power and Set Yourself Free
books.author: Alexandra Elle
books.description: A guide to self-reflection through writing, mixing her own story with conversations with other women and prompts readers can work through. It treats journaling as a way to notice old patterns and choose new ones.

books.title: The Company We Keep: Friendship, Connection, and Redefining What It Means to Grow Together
books.author: Alexandra Elle
books.description: Her 2026 book on friendship as adults: how bonds change, how to tend them and when to let them go. Reflections and journal prompts sit alongside her own experiences.

books.title: After the Rain: Gentle Reminders for Healing, Courage, and Self-Love
books.author: Alexandra Elle
books.description: Short personal essays drawn from her own life, each followed by affirmations and a writing exercise. The book is built for slow reading and returning to over time.

books.title: Neon Soul: A Collection of Poetry and Prose
books.author: Alexandra Elle
books.description: An early collection of poems and short prose on self-worth, love and growing up. It shows the personal, plain-spoken voice that runs through her later books.

books.title: In Courage Journal: A Daily Practice for Self-Discovery
books.author: Alexandra Elle
books.description: A guided journal that accompanies After the Rain, with daily prompts and space to write. It is meant to help readers build a regular reflective writing habit.

books.title: Today I Affirm: A Journal that Nurtures Self-Care
books.author: Alexandra Elle
books.description: A prompt journal pairing affirmations with short writing exercises for everyday self-care. It suits readers who want a gentle, structured way into journaling.

books.title: Affirmation Cards: How We Heal through Self-Love, Joy, and Manifestation
books.author: Alexandra Elle
books.description: A boxed deck of affirmation cards that complements How We Heal. Each card offers a short phrase to reflect on or write about.

free_resources.title: Alex Elle on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Short guided meditations and spoken affirmations on gratitude, clarity, feeling seen and coming back to yourself. All of them can be played free in the app or on the web.

free_resources.title: Here for Now (newsletter)
free_resources.description: Her free newsletter on Substack, formerly called Gratitude Journal. Posts mix personal essays with journal prompts and notes on writing and everyday life.
